head_commit.message:
test: split body-clause classifiers from representative floor witnesses (#4456)

* perf(tests): split body-clause classifier from floor integration (#3904)

Keep full PR-body phrasing coverage in the classifier matrix while crossing
prompt_coverage and _apply_coverage_floor only on one witness per required-channel
outcome class, reducing 963 integration cases to 54 without dropping semantics.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* perf(tests): bound relative-qualifier scope and split its coverage floor (#3904)

Parent versus local availability stays fully crossed, while verb and condition aliases no longer multiply prompt-floor evaluations.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* test: add _required_evidence_options assertions to body-clause tests

- Add independent _required_evidence_options assertions to
  test_body_clause_matrix_preserves_independent_destinations across
  the full 107-wording body-clause corpus (856 cases)
- Add test_integration_floor_split_preserves_distinct_outcomes_and_full_status_channels
  to verify integration_floor_split entries: one witness per outcome,
  all BODY_CLAUSE_CASES channel sets covered, status/channel parametrization
  validated against actual decorators and BODY_CLAUSE_FLOOR_CASES
- Fix both full-retention claims in docs to exempt integration_floor_split entries

Generated by Mistral Vibe.
Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>

* test: cross description alias with every product-component voice

Active, perfect, progressive, and both passive agent positions use different recognizers, so the body/description spelling has to stay on the voice spine instead of active voice only.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* perf(tests): bound the measured dominant delivery-destination matrices (#3904)

Replace the twelve slowest remaining full products with semantic cores, lexical spines, and pairwise witnesses so alias crosses no longer multiply every grammar axis.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* perf(tests): split evidence-channel checks from coverage-floor integration (#3904)

Keep full classifier matrices on _required_evidence_channels and _required_evidence_options, and run prompt_coverage plus _apply_coverage_floor only on outcome witnesses. That removes the repeated floor work inside the dominant delivery, prompt-coverage, and body-integration products.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* test: record causal breaks of evidence channels and the coverage floor (#3904)

Empty _required_evidence_channels fails the 380 positive product-component rows, and a PASS bypass of _apply_coverage_floor fails the 48 required-but-absent floor rows. Both mutations are restored byte-for-byte, with the fail and pass transcripts kept for the selector test.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* ci: name collection-budget breaches in the Python CI summary

The case-count signal was only a boolean inside JSON. Name function and file breaches, print the review procedure, and keep the check nonblocking.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* test: record the hosted Gate before/after for verifier grammar (#3904)

Compare the required Python 3.13 and 3.14 jobs under the same Gate workflow, workers, lockfile, and coverage settings. Verifier executed branches are unchanged, and the Python 3.13 job remains 4s over ten minutes.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
Co-authored-by: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>

head_commit.message:
Retire GitHub Models as a fallback provider (#4362)

* Retire GitHub Models as a fallback provider

Owner decision 2026-10-31: GitHub Models is no longer used as a fallback.
- config/llm_slots.json (root + template): drop the slot3 github-models row;
  the verifier's slot 3 stays the Muse capacity backup.
- config/model_registry.json (root + template): move the provisional
  verifier-balanced/github-models selection to selection_history.
- tools/llm_registry.py default_slots: OpenAI then Anthropic only.
- task_decomposer: no GITHUB_TOKEN-only branch to github-models.
- config/model_eval_candidates.json regenerated from the registry.
- Tests now assert a GITHUB_TOKEN alone builds no client.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Treat consumer slots for retired selections as advisory; isolate no-fallback tests

- check_model_registry_freshness: a slot naming a selection retired in
  selection_history (superseded_by "retired") reports advisory retired_slot,
  not blocking missing_selection, since consumer llm_slots.json is create-only.
- Tests clear LANGCHAIN_SLOT* and registry overrides before asserting GitHub
  Models is unavailable.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Refuse slots for retired selections at runtime, including explicit pins

load_slot_config skips any slot whose (profile, provider) selection was retired
(selection_history superseded_by "retired", no active selection), so a stale
create-only consumer slot naming github-models with an explicit model can never
build a client. The freshness finding stays advisory because runtime refuses it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
